notes: This file is the reproducibility pin for every record under sim/.
open_pdks_commit is the volare version hash for the sky130 PDK family;
the corner runner reads $PDK_ROOT/$PDK back through its symlink and
refuses to run against a different version unless --allow-pdk-mismatch
is passed (in which case the record carries the mismatch).
process_corners are the basic N/P device sections that actually exist in
the PDK ngspice library (verified against the .lib sections of
libs.tech/combined/sky130.lib.spice). tt/ss/ff/sf/fs are the standard
MOS/BJT (nonfet.spice-driven) corners -- they also gate PNP Is/Bf/Nf via
the same corners/<name>/nonfet.spice includes. ll/hh (added for #4's
resistor-flavor characterization) are the resistor/capacitor-only skew
corners: they ride on the nominal tt MOS/BJT corner (all ll/hh/hl/lh
'.lib' sections '.include corners/tt.spice') and instead vary
parameters_res_low.spice / parameters_res_high.spice, which is where
sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po / __res_xhigh_po sheet resistance actually
changes -- confirmed empirically: the standard tt/ss/ff/sf/fs corners
give byte-identical resistor values (all five include
parameters_res_nom.spice), so resistor-value process sensitivity only
shows up on the ll/hh axis. hl/lh (res value tied to the *other*
axis's cap corner) and the *_mm / mc mismatch sections also exist and
remain available to experiment manifests that need them but are not
added to this pinned list until a manifest actually uses them.
